observations: Photo shows a boxed electronic keyboard instrument wrapped in plastic/film.
Keys are visible (full-size style with many black/white keys).
There is a printed label/branding on the box, but it is not clearly readable in these photos.
No close-up of model number, brand name, ports, or control panel details.

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: Brand/model and audio/sound quality cannot be confirmed from the photos; the box text is not readable enough to verify 'Quality London' or any sound specs.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (the box may not be 'Quality London' or may be a different model than expected).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the box label showing brand + exact model number (or a photo of the keyboard’s nameplate/model sticker).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used electronic keyboard with unknown model and unknown condition.

risks.risk: Not tested / may not work (keyboard could have dead keys, faulty power, or missing parts).
risks.proof: Video clip showing power-on, playing several keys, and working speakers/headphones (or a short audio recording of notes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, manual).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter, pedal, cables, manual) and a shot of the keyboard ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: Damage from shipping/storage (even if boxed, it could be cracked or warped).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the box corners and any visible dents/cracks; plus a photo of the keyboard after unboxing.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for cosmetic/packaging damage.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the box label showing brand and exact model number (front + side label).
Video: power-on and playing keys (showing speakers/headphones output).
Photo of included accessories (adapter/pedal/manual) and a photo of the keyboard ports.
If possible, photo after unboxing showing the full control panel and any visible damage.
response.reason: The photos only show a plastic-wrapped boxed keyboard with unreadable brand/model details, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without knowing the exact model and whether it works.
